name: Pineapple and Pearls
changeNote: Dropped from two stars to one
dinnerNote: Four-course menu with choices, a few cocktails included
dinnerNoteZh: 四道菜套餐（每道可選），含數杯雞尾酒

menus.name: Four-course menu
menus.note: A choice at each course plus a few surprises, with a few cocktails or mocktails included; same price in the dining room, at the chef's counter and at the bar. Fancy wine pairing $195, Extra Fancy $500, zero-proof pairing $95.

bookingOpens: Online on Resy, one month ahead. Pairings can be added when booking or ordered on the night. Solo diners are seated nightly at the chef's counter.
cancellation: Cancelling or changing the date within 30 days of the booking forfeits the full amount for the party, bar seats included; earlier cancellations are refunded in full. Bookings can be transferred to someone else.
groups: One dining-room table seats up to six and the private dining room up to 12, both bookable online. For a fully private dinner for seven or more, or a full or partial buyout, email events@rosesrestaurantgroup.com.
dressCode: No dress code, but guests are encouraged to dress up ('your best New Year's Eve outfit').
